planets.name: TOI-1743 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1743 with a 4.27-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1743 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1743. Its orbit and size follow Yalçinkaya et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
